answer: The admission burn is multiplied by 2 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. The delta multiplier is published, charged in thread, and walnut lists each payment. A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, since the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. A farm of 2228 identities would post 843 proofs and burn roughly 81 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
